node.title: C36 rich overlap is supported on one explicit derivative-ideal integer per order
node.statement: For every dyadic order n>=4 there is an explicit positive odd integer e_n, defined as the degree-root of the Galois-invariant norm of the first-nineteen-derivative ideals of the ordered shifted-product polynomial, such that every prime p=1 mod n satisfies p^X_18 | e_n. Hence X_18=0 for every row prime p not dividing e_n, while 17 log(e_n)<=300n^2 log(p) implies the exact C36 target. The proof retains the quotient weight by evaluating once for every ordered nonidentity quotient lift. It does not bound or factor e_n, so the universal critical leaf remains open.
